title: PMMA beam in 3-point bending
summary: Real photos of a speckled acrylic beam loaded at mid-span until it breaks, with the load cell's force at each photo. Gives the deflection, bending stress and E.

credit.creators: R. Delorme, I. Tabiai, P. Diehl, L. Laberge Lebel, M. Lévesque
credit.title: PMMA 3 point bending test until failure loaded in displacement
credit.changes: Camera 0 of the stereo pair only. Image 32 (the reference) and every second image from 33 to 97 kept. Each cropped to (40, 820)–(2420, 2048) and saved as 8-bit PNG. The load cell's force at those images written to pmma_loads.csv (N); frame_index.csv maps each file to its original image; truth_deflection.csv is the authors' deflection at the load point, averaged over the probe circle the app uses.
